description: Shutdown a Windows EC2 instance in AWS.

instance_id.description: The EC2 instance ID to stop.

region.description: The AWS region that contains the EC2 instance.

wait.description: Wait until the instance reaches the stopped state.

dry_run.description: Check whether the caller has permission without stopping the instance.

poll_seconds.description: Seconds between status checks when wait is true.

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum seconds to wait for the instance to stop.
